name: english
text: Let's go through what to take with you for: Cheque bounce. Now the papers. There are 7 of them. You already have 1 — well done. First, bank return memo. You already have this one. Second, the original cheque. The court will need to see the original.

name: english-2
text: Third, bank statement showing the cheque deposit and its return. Shows the cheque was presented within its validity. Fourth, copy of the demand notice, postal receipts and delivery tracking. Delivery date starts the 15-day payment window and then the one-month window to file. And finally, the issuer's full name and address. Needed for the notice and the complaint. These papers may help your lawyer. Don't worry if you can't find some — still go and meet your lawyer.

name: hindi
text: चलिए देखते हैं कि चेक बाउंस के लिए आपको क्या-क्या साथ ले जाना है। अब काग़ज़ों की बात। कुल सात काग़ज़ हैं, और एक आपके पास पहले से है — बहुत अच्छा। पहला, बैंक की रिटर्न मेमो। ये आपके पास पहले से है। दूसरा, असली चेक। कोर्ट को असली चेक देखना होगा।

name: odia
text: ଚାଲନ୍ତୁ ଦେଖିବା, ଚେକ୍ ବାଉନ୍ସ ପାଇଁ ଆପଣଙ୍କୁ କଣ କଣ ସାଙ୍ଗରେ ନେବାକୁ ହେବ। ମୋଟ ସାତଟି କାଗଜ ଦରକାର। ପ୍ରଥମରେ, ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କର ରିଟର୍ନ ମେମୋ। ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟରେ, ମୂଳ ଚେକ୍। କୋର୍ଟ ମୂଳ ଚେକ୍ ଦେଖିବାକୁ ଚାହିଁବେ। ଚିନ୍ତା କରନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ, ସବୁ କାଗଜ ନ ମିଳିଲେ ବି ଆଡଭୋକେଟଙ୍କୁ ଭେଟନ୍ତୁ।
